issues.quote: what matters is that each time it demands my attention, that it is not I who command them but they who already command me
In effect, you become the slave of this many-headed beast.
I cannot get past a human being.
Whereas on mine I meet a person everywhere and always.
you who through the windows of houses, thousands of black mouths, breathe out your stench forever
in your variety of colors and forms
You want to suck me dry, all my blood, like a vampire.

strengths.quote: I feel another existence entering mine the way air comes in through windows and doors, the way the waters of tributaries flow into a river.
I confess I envy the planets: they have their orbits, and nothing stands in their way.
you bellow with pain, with joy, with rage. Like an animal.
your eyes, curious and greedy, crawl into me
You do not merely walk beside me, you climb inside me.
